request:
Which methods of the Group class in src/click/core.py override a method that its base class Command (same file) defines itself under the same name? Count only methods written in the body of Command, not ones Command inherits; __init__ counts as an override. Give the symbol ID of the Group method.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
explanation: This joins Group methods to the class ancestry of Command, then finds a method defined directly in Command's body with the same name. The result lists the Group methods that override Command methods.
sql: SELECT g.symbol_id AS symbol_id FROM code.symbols g JOIN code.symbols cg ON cg.file_id = g.file_id AND cg.qualname = 'Group' AND cg.kind = 'class' JOIN code.class_ancestry a ON a.class_symbol_id = cg.symbol_id JOIN code.symbols b ON b.symbol_id = a.ancestor_symbol_id AND b.name = 'Command' AND b.file_id = 'src/click/core.py' JOIN code.symbols m ON m.file_id = b.file_id AND m.qualname = b.name || '.' || g.name AND m.kind = 'method' WHERE g.kind = 'method' AND g.file_id = 'src/click/core.py' ORDER BY g.symbol_id
